author: sarah.tran
_comment: Sarah: v1.0 copied name, entity and soft-circle amount and left every erisa.* field blank, so the four dry-run pensions arrived with no BPI flag until each LP filled Schedule A. v1.1 derives a provisional BPI class from Relata so erisa_aggregate_cap_guard.ts can project the Section 6.4 aggregate from the moment of prefill. Reuse for any Delaware parallel-fund launch whose GP runs Relata; only source.list and the vehicle map change.

fieldMap._comment: Display only. Never used as the legal name.
Exact name from the plan document or trust agreement; the LP can still edit it in the form.
UNMAPPED blocks submission until the LP picks a value.
Relata keeps the last 4 digits only (e.g. **-***4417). The full SSN/EIN is collected solely in the encrypted W-9 step: never prefill it, never copy it into CRM notes.
LP-editable. Every edit fires a new webhook delivery, so the guard re-counts the whole book.
Integer cents read by the guard. Rate date is the target closing date.
Ardent Growth Fund VII, L.P. = MAIN; Ardent Growth Parallel Fund VII, L.P. = PARALLEL.

Provisional; Schedule A Lines A1-A7 are authoritative. A municipal employees' retirement system is a governmental plan (ERISA §3(32)) and NOT a BPI under §3(42). A bare 'Pension' tag cannot tell us which, so it falls to UNCLASSIFIED.
Only for PLAN_ASSET_ENTITY: counted to the extent of its equity held by BPIs (ERISA §3(42)); Schedule A Line A3.
Disregarded from the 25% test unless the holder is itself a BPI (§2510.3-101(f)(1); Addendum Section 6.3).
A hint only. Rule 506(c) still requires reasonable-steps verification in SubFlow (Addendum Section 3.2).
A hint for the Section 2.3 QP representation; the LP re-certifies in the form.
Signatory invite. Not used by any ERISA logic.

postPrefill.then: erisa.bpi_weight_bps = erisa.bpi_class in ['ERISA_TITLE_I_PLAN','CODE_4975_PLAN'] ? 10000 : erisa.bpi_class == 'PLAN_ASSET_ENTITY' ? erisa.plan_asset_bpi_pct * 100 : erisa.bpi_class == 'UNCLASSIFIED' ? null : 0
postPrefill._comment: null means unknown; the guard counts it as a full BPI (fail closed).

postPrefill.then: require section erisa.schedule_a_worksheet; preselect the line implied by erisa.bpi_class (A1-A7), unconfirmed
postPrefill._comment: Every Subscriber completes Schedule A (Addendum Section 4.1). Prefill only suggests a line; the signatory must confirm it.

postPrefill.then: erisa.bpi_class = erisa.schedule_a.bpi_class; notify 'chloe.nguyen' to fix the Relata record
postPrefill._comment: The LP's own certification beats CRM data. Correct the CRM, not the form.

postPrefill.then: drop the note from the prefill payload; alert '#case-ardent-growth-vii'
postPrefill._comment: The dry run found a full EIN pasted into an Relata note. It must never reach SubFlow or our logs.

postPrefill.then: webhook erisa_aggregate_cap_guard (event subscription.prefilled); show the WARN/HOLD banner in the GP review queue
postPrefill._comment: At prefill the guard only shows a banner. It blocks only on subscription.pre_countersign.
